components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: Sections are rows of claim and consequence separated by 1px rules, never cards.
components.html:
Corrections stick.

Fix something once. The fix is kept, attributed, and survives every rebuild.

You can see why.

Every decision shows where it came from and how sure Sema was.
components.css: .ds-ledger { display: grid; gap: 1px; background: var(--rule, #2a3040); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #2a3040); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #2a3040); font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #e8e6df); } .ds-ledger-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr; gap: 24px; padding: 32px 0; background: var(--ground, #0a0d19); } .ds-claim { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-consequence { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 58ch; }

narrative.overview: The page is a chart of one graph. A near-black ground carries a faint grid plane and a field of small nodes; silver-blue draws structure and amber marks signal only. Type is IBM Plex Sans for reading and Plex Mono for annotation, with the Cormorant wordmark as the single serif. Nothing is rounded and nothing floats. The landing site is one graph the reader scrolls through; every section is a chapter in which the same fixed graph plane does one thing, and the page refuses the stacked-blocks arrangement.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first; light is a full second mode with the same geometry and a darker amber.
Amber rationed to the CTA fill, the graph core, Blocked, the break, the quote's second sentence.
Hairline rules do the work borders and shadows do elsewhere.
Figures are authored SVG plates with live text, themed through tokens.
One scroll clock, one easing, end state under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Amber marks a decision or a call, never ornament. More than one amber fill per screen is wrong.

rules.name: The One Ground Rule
rules.body: Every surface is --ground. A container is a border, not a tint.

rules.name: The Lead-In Rule
rules.body: Structure inside running text is a bold lead-in on the paragraph, not a label above it.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no drop shadow, no gradient fills; the radius and shadow scales are removed at the theme level.

dos: Do put every colour through the tokens.
Do keep one filled amber control per viewport.
Do build sections as ledger rows, tables, one-line rows or numbered theses.
Do draw figures in Figma with live text and export as SVG.
Do render the end state when motion is off.
donts: Don't add radius, shadows, gradients or tinted surfaces.
Don't add mono labels above paragraphs.
Don't write "not shipped" anywhere but the roadmap's eyebrow.
Don't name mechanisms on the page; sell by result.
Don't add a second scroll clock or easing.
narrative.notCanonized: The two eyebrows (S5 Proof, S8 Roadmap) are a user-waived exception to the craft floor (max one per three sections), not a system rule; they are not recorded as a component.
